items.headline: Bitcoin Trades Below Popular Long-Term Models, Raising Bear Market Concerns
items.summary: Bitcoin is currently priced under several widely followed long-term valuation models. It has also broken historical support levels that once signaled recoveries from past downturns.
items.sourceTitle: 4 Scary Bitcoin Charts That Suggest This Bear Market Is Different

items.headline: Bitcoin's Macro Backdrop Shifts Ahead of 2027
items.summary: Bitcoin began 2026 expecting easier borrowing and better liquidity, but markets now anticipate US interest rates rising to 4.50%–4.75% by June 2027. Analysts at BloFin Research say this could keep pressure on the asset.
items.sourceTitle: How Bitcoin’s Macro Trend Changed in 2026

items.headline: Large Bitcoin holders keep buying despite thinner profit margins
items.summary: Data from CryptoQuant indicates Bitcoin whales are departing from their usual fourth-quarter selling behaviour during a market slump.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin whales pile into BTC despite shrinking profit cushion

items.headline: Paper Suggests Theoretical Shortcut for Bitcoin Key Math
items.summary: A new paper claims a theoretical shortcut relating to Bitcoin key cryptography, based on a construction still under review. Ledger's Charles Guillemet and Blockstream's Adam Back see no practical shortcut for 256-bit keys.
items.sourceTitle: New Paper Claims Theoretical Shortcut for Bitcoin Key Math

items.headline: Spain Lets Authorities Freeze Crypto Accounts Without Court Sign-Off
items.summary: Spain has passed a new law that lets authorities block crypto transactions for up to 10 days. The measure is intended to strengthen financial oversight.
items.sourceTitle: Spain Moves to Freeze Crypto Accounts Without Need for Court Approval

items.headline: Large Bitcoin options expiry settles amid traders' downside hedging
items.summary: A major Bitcoin options expiry this month has settled, as traders increasingly seek protection against further losses. Some are hedging against a possible fall to $40,000 before year-end.
items.sourceTitle: $7 Billion in Bitcoin Options Just Expired: Here’s What It Means

items.headline: CryptoQuant links bitcoin recovery to rising USDT supply
items.summary: CryptoQuant says a sustained bitcoin price recovery would require stablecoin tether (USDT) supply to grow again. The excerpt gives no further data or detail.
items.sourceTitle: CryptoQuant says bitcoin price recovery needs USDT supply growth

items.headline: Bitcoin slides below $60K as large options expiry hits
items.summary: Bitcoin fell under $60,000 as about $7 billion in options contracts expired, while November ETF outflows exceeded $5 billion. Experts cautioned that downside risks could linger.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin’s Thanksgiving Rally Unravels as $7B Options Expiry Rocks Markets

items.headline: Russia's VTB Lets Qualified Investors Trade Crypto
items.summary: Russian state-linked bank VTB is launching crypto trading for qualified investors, starting with trades made outside an exchange. Clients must pass a knowledge test and hold crypto in a separate account the bank manages.
items.sourceTitle: Russia’s VTB Opens Crypto Trading for Qualified Investors

items.headline: EU banking watchdog urges safeguards for crypto firms using DeFi lending
items.summary: The European banking regulator has renewed its call for crypto firms that direct customers into decentralized lending to have safeguards assessed. The article also reports that USDT leads borrowing on several DeFi protocols reviewed.
items.sourceTitle: USDT leads borrowing on four of six DeFi protocols examined by Europe’s banking watchdog

items.headline: Asian nations plan working group on digital payments and crypto rules
items.summary: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN have decided to form a working group focused on digital payments and crypto regulation. The move follows a May meeting in Uzbekistan, where cross-border digital payments were identified as a new area of cooperation.
items.sourceTitle: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN to form working group on digital payments, crypto regulation

items.headline: Bluefin Plans to Close Sui Perpetual Futures Platform in December
items.summary: Bluefin has told traders to close their positions before 4 p.m. ET on December 4. Per DefiLlama's 30-day data, rivals Aftermath Finance and DipCoin handled more Sui perpetuals volume than Bluefin.
items.sourceTitle: Bluefin to Shut Down Perpetual Futures on Sui Dec. 4

items.headline: Binance Lifts Post-Hack Withdrawal Suspension on Most Networks
items.summary: Binance says withdrawals are now open on nearly all networks. A small number remain paused for maintenance or upgrades.
items.sourceTitle: Binance Says Post-Hack Withdrawal Suspension Is Over

items.headline: Fidelity files with SEC for spot Chainlink ETF
items.summary: Fidelity Investments has submitted a filing to the SEC seeking to launch a spot Chainlink exchange-traded fund. The move extends its crypto ETF lineup beyond bitcoin, ethereum and solana.
items.sourceTitle: Fidelity Pushes Beyond Bitcoin With Chainlink ETF Filing

items.headline: Spain proposes letting regulator freeze crypto accounts
items.summary: A new decree would let Spain's financial intelligence unit suspend crypto accounts. Firms that fail to comply could face fines.
items.sourceTitle: Spain moves to grant financial watchdog power to freeze crypto accounts

items.headline: Economist warns hawkish Fed could hit crypto in December
items.summary: Economist Robin Brooks cautioned that stocks could face serious consequences if the Federal Reserve does not offer dovish signals before the FOMC blackout period. The warning links monetary policy expectations to broader risk assets, including crypto.
items.sourceTitle: Crypto on notice as hawkish Fed risks December ‘meltdown’

items.headline: Coinbase CEO Says Investors Rotate From Bitcoin Into IPOs, Then Back
items.summary: Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong said investors have historically sold bitcoin to buy into major IPOs and later returned to it. He argued bitcoin remains important for investors expecting higher inflation and money printing.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase CEO Says Investors Swap Bitcoin for Big IPOs, Then Rotate Back

items.headline: House committee advances bitcoin reserve bill, but passage looks difficult
items.summary: A House committee has moved forward a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill. With the current Congress expected to adjourn within weeks, there is little time for the full chamber to pass it.
items.sourceTitle: House Committee advances Strategic Bitcoin Reserve bill with narrow path to passage

items.headline: Lido tightens Ethereum staking penalties as operators get larger validator access
items.summary: Lido is changing its penalty rules for Ethereum staking operators and expanding their access to larger validators. The move follows a March slashing event that involved six validators.
items.sourceTitle: Lido tightens Ethereum staking penalties as operators gain access to larger validators

items.headline: Ripple partners with Turkish bank, eyeing wider XRP use there
items.summary: Ripple says its custody software is deployed at Yapı Kredi in Turkey. A route for converting Turkish lira into withdrawable XRP has not been publicly confirmed.
items.sourceTitle: Ripple’s latest banking partnership opens another route to XRP adoption in Turkey

items.headline: Attack redirects Bitcoin miners' compute power to steal rewards
items.summary: Braiins has warned that an attacker is diverting miners' computing power to take bitcoin mining rewards. The attack reportedly exploits unencrypted connections.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin miners hit by hashrate hijacking attack exploiting unencrypted connections

items.headline: Bit Digital Sells ETH to Repay $50M Galaxy Loan
items.summary: Bit Digital said it sold 29,825 ETH to repay $50 million in secured borrowings from Galaxy Digital. The move is part of a wider trend of publicly traded digital asset treasury companies selling reserves to cut leverage.
items.sourceTitle: Bit Digital Sells Nearly 30,000 ETH to Slash Galaxy Debt by $50 Million

items.headline: Fidelity seeks listing for spot Chainlink fund on Nasdaq
items.summary: Fidelity has filed for a proposed fund that would hold LINK tokens directly without staking them. The filing is not a launch, and the product would join existing offerings from Grayscale and Bitwise.
items.sourceTitle: Fidelity Files for Spot Chainlink Fund on Nasdaq

items.headline: US Bitcoin reserve bill advances to House Union Calendar
items.summary: A proposed US bitcoin reserve bill has been placed on the House Union Calendar. Under one section, federally acquired bitcoin would be held for 20 years after enactment, and House passage is still pending.
items.sourceTitle: US Bitcoin Reserve Bill Reaches House Union Calendar

items.headline: CleanSpark sells Bitcoin to fund AI expansion amid heavy losses
items.summary: Bitcoin miner CleanSpark is selling its bitcoin holdings to raise cash for possible acquisitions. The story also notes that a price drop can make borrowing against bitcoin more demanding, as shown by its Two Prime facility.
items.sourceTitle: CleanSpark is selling Bitcoin to fund its AI expansion as annual losses approach $1 billion

items.headline: Finmo Adds USDC and USDT to Business Accounts
items.summary: Finmo has enabled businesses to hold, receive and pay in USDC and USDT from its Business Account alongside fiat balances. Stablecoin balances can also be viewed next to bank accounts in Finmo Treasury.
items.sourceTitle: Finmo Adds USDC and USDT Support to Business Accounts

items.headline: CFTC lets US exchanges count Bitcoin reserves at a discount
items.summary: CFTC staff say exchanges and clearinghouses can count qualifying crypto toward reserves at a haircut. A worked example illustrates how the annual buffer could fall short.
items.sourceTitle: The CFTC opens the door to Bitcoin reserves at US exchanges with a 20% catch

items.headline: SEC staff grants Molecule no-action relief for research tokens
items.summary: SEC staff said it would not recommend enforcement against Molecule over utility tokens that let people back scientific research. The relief covers the company's token model as described.
items.sourceTitle: SEC staff gives Molecule no-action relief for scientific research tokens

items.headline: Ethereum Foundation Ranks AI Risk Above Quantum Computing Threat
items.summary: The Ethereum Foundation has expanded its protocol security team and is focusing on a cryptographic overhaul. It cites AI advances as a threat to the mathematical assumptions protecting crypto assets.
items.sourceTitle: Ethereum Foundation Says AI Is a More Urgent Threat Than Quantum Computing

items.headline: Kraken's Krak Plans US Credit Cards Supporting USDC
items.summary: Kraken's Krak is planning credit cards in the US with a USDC option. The top cashback tier requires a $150,000 Krak balance and Krakpass membership, while a secured card locks USDC and earns variable yield.
items.sourceTitle: Kraken’s Krak Plans US Credit Cards With USDC Option

items.headline: Coldcard explains why Bitcoin wallet flaw escaped detection for years
items.summary: Coinkite, the maker of Coldcard, described why repeated security reviews did not catch the flaw. The company has not yet decided on compensation for affected customers.
items.sourceTitle: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years

items.headline: Hong Kong sets approval rules for banks holding customers' crypto
items.summary: Standalone custodians would generally need a license, while banks would need to register alongside existing custody standards. The rules concern how crypto held for customers is overseen in Hong Kong.
items.sourceTitle: Hong Kong wants banks to secure new approval before holding customers’ crypto

items.headline: CFTC Guidance Lets Crypto Count Toward Reserve Buffers
items.summary: Staff guidance from the CFTC allows swap venues and clearinghouses to count Bitcoin, Ethereum and stablecoins toward a 12-month operating-cost buffer, with certain conditions attached.
items.sourceTitle: What the CFTC’s New Crypto Reserves Guidance Actually Allows—And What It Doesn’t

items.headline: BlackRock fund in Hong Kong adds stablecoin payment option
items.summary: BlackRock's HKD Digital Liquidity Fund now offers tokenized units starting at HK$10. Stablecoin payments through the fund are limited to professional investors.
items.sourceTitle: BlackRock Opens Hong Kong Fund to Stablecoin Payments

items.headline: Bitcoin dips near $60,000 as Nvidia-driven rally fades
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped back toward $60,000 after a brief lift tied to Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia. Analysts say the move was a short-lived reflex that did not ease macro pressures on bitcoin as a risk asset.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin slips back toward $60,000 as Jensen Huang’s Nvidia return rally fizzles

items.headline: LendingUSA and Cross River Bank launch bitcoin-backed loan platform
items.summary: LendingUSA and Cross River Bank have rolled out a lending platform secured by bitcoin, letting eligible borrowers get cash without selling their holdings. Loans range from $10,000 to $250,000.
items.sourceTitle: LendingUSA, Cross River Bank Debut Bitcoin-Backed Loans Up to $250K

items.headline: UK Rules Bar Crypto Venues From Market-Making on Their Own Platforms
items.summary: Under new UK rules, market making in qualifying cryptoassets on qualifying platforms will fall outside principal-dealing permission. Separate final FCA rules prohibit firms from making markets on UK platforms they operate from October 25, 2027.
items.sourceTitle: UK Qualifying Crypto Venues Face Own-Platform Market-Making Ban

items.headline: Fidelity Analyst Sees Bitcoin Quantum Risk as Mostly Addressed
items.summary: A Fidelity analyst says the quantum threat to Bitcoin is largely solved, though a decentralized network may be slow to adopt the fixes. The piece asks whether holders will upgrade.
items.sourceTitle: Fidelity Analyst Says Bitcoin Quantum Threat Is Largely Solved: Will Holders Upgrade?

items.headline: Strive Makes No Bitcoin Purchases Last Week, Holds 43,404 BTC
items.summary: Strive neither bought bitcoin nor sold stock last week, keeping its holdings at 43,404 BTC, according to a Monday 8-K filing. Its ASST shares traded near $15.55.
items.sourceTitle: Strive (ASST) Buys No Bitcoin Last Week, Holdings Stay at 43,404 BTC

items.headline: Solana memory checks may cause some older app transactions to fail
items.summary: New memory checks on Solana could make certain older application transactions fail. A replay surfaced an Anchor account handoff issue, and a separate change removes validator data copies.
items.sourceTitle: Solana’s new memory checks could make some older app transactions fail

items.headline: Bithumb suspends CYBER deposits and withdrawals, trading continues
items.summary: Bithumb halted CYBER deposits and withdrawals over a suspected security issue, while trading remains open. Kraken separately warned of possible delays for CYBER deposits sent via Optimism.
items.sourceTitle: Bithumb halts CYBER deposits and withdrawals while trading stays open

items.headline: UK plans to bar exchanges from market-making on own platforms
items.summary: Under UK proposals, firms that make markets in spot Bitcoin on qualifying platforms would be exempt from principal-dealing permission for that activity, with separate venue rules also applying.
items.sourceTitle: UK to ban crypto exchanges from making markets on their own platforms as Bitcoin rules change

items.headline: Peter Brandt Compares Bitcoin Sell-Off to Past Steep Drops
items.summary: Veteran trader Peter Brandt noted that bitcoin previously fell at least 75% after parabolic rallies. He questioned whether the current decline from the record high is following that same pattern.
items.sourceTitle: Peter Brandt Links 75% Bitcoin Drops to Parabolic Rallies

items.headline: Bitcoin climbs above $61,000, then surrenders part of weekend gains
items.summary: Bitcoin moved above $61,000 on Sunday, with Binance perpetual futures recording far more net buying than its spot market. The price later gave back about a third of the weekend rally.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin reclaims $61,000 before giving back a third of the weekend rally

items.headline: Deribit outage affects Bitcoin hedgers; Coinbase US derivatives unaffected
items.summary: Two trading interruptions disrupted global Bitcoin and Ether perpetuals that share Deribit execution. Coinbase said its US derivatives were not affected.
items.sourceTitle: Deribit outage hit Bitcoin hedgers on Coinbase

items.headline: Quantum threat to Bitcoin security may outlast upgrade timelines
items.summary: Quantum computers cannot currently break Bitcoin's network security, but Leo Fan cautions that upgrading the network and moving funds could take longer than expected.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin's quantum security challenge extends to bridges, custodians and millions of coins

items.headline: Bitcoin Miners Squeezed as Hashrate Climbs Back Above 1 ZH/s
items.summary: Bitcoin's hashrate has recovered to above 1,000 EH/s after a drop of about 100 EH/s, even as the price fell to levels not seen since early September 2024. Miner profitability has become tighter.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Mining Profits Turn Ugly Despite Hashrate’s Return Above 1 ZH/s

items.headline: AI-assisted research uncovers medium-severity Bitcoin Core node flaw
items.summary: Bitcoin Core disclosed a medium-severity vulnerability that let malicious peers temporarily stall nodes via repeated transaction announcements. The flaw was found using AI-assisted security research.
items.sourceTitle: AI Finds Bitcoin Core Security Flaw That Could Temporarily Freeze Nodes

items.headline: Central Banks Privately Weigh Bitcoin Alongside Gold Holdings
items.summary: Central bank officials reportedly say gold and bitcoin share a key appeal in self-custody, and that at least one central bank is known to hold bitcoin. The excerpt also notes that 7% of surveyed central banks were considering digital assets.
items.sourceTitle: Behind Closed Doors, Central Banks Build a Case for Bitcoin—But With Gold

items.headline: Cyber probes suspected bridge exploit as Korean exchanges pause transfers
items.summary: Upbit and Bithumb have both suspended deposits and withdrawals for the CYBER token due to a suspected security incident. The project is reportedly investigating a possible bridge exploit.
items.sourceTitle: Cyber investigating suspected $1 million bridge exploit as Upbit, Bithumb freeze transfers

items.headline: Bitcoin rebounds 9% from two-year low back above $60,000
items.summary: Bitcoin climbed about 9% off a two-year low to reclaim the $60,000 level, as traders look ahead to Monday's stock market open. A sell-off had erased $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly long bets on rising prices.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low to retake $60,000 as traders eye Monday’s stock open

items.headline: Singapore plans sandbox for AI agents making stablecoin payments
items.summary: A planned sandbox would examine how banks and payment providers confirm an AI agent's authority before it carries out stablecoin payments. The excerpt gives few further details.
items.sourceTitle: Singapore wants to test stablecoin payments by AI agents

items.headline: SEC Says Fake Crypto Exchanges Defrauded US Investors of $37M
items.summary: The SEC alleges eight Colorado-registered entities, likely operated from overseas, impersonated legitimate advisers and crypto platforms, including faking SEC certificates and filings. The scheme reportedly defrauded U.S. investors of more than $37 million.
items.sourceTitle: Fraudsters Used Fake Crypto Exchanges to Steal $37 Million, SEC Alleges

items.headline: Bitwise CIO Says Washington Politics Are Hurting Crypto Growth
items.summary: Bitwise CIO Matt Hougan argues that regulatory constraints are preventing crypto from delivering on its promise to upgrade the financial system. He says current rules block changes needed for innovation.
items.sourceTitle: Washington Politics Are Crushing Crypto Industry Ambitions, Warns Bitwise CIO

items.headline: Coins.ph restricts transfers to self-custody wallets
items.summary: The Philippine exchange now allows external crypto transfers only to regulated exchanges and requires counterparty details for every amount. The change limits withdrawals to self-custody wallets.
items.sourceTitle: Coins.ph Halts Transfers With Self-Custody Wallets

items.headline: Bitcoin dips under $60,000 as crypto liquidations hit $1.57B
items.summary: Bitcoin fell below $60,000, and crypto liquidations totaled $1.57 billion over 24 hours. The excerpt offers no further detail on the cause.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Falls Below $60,000 as Crypto Liquidations Reach $1.57 Billion in 24 Hours - Hokanews

items.headline: Bitquery Tracks Over $1.58M Stolen in Fluidkey Exploit
items.summary: Fluidkey says a flaw in a logging tool let an attacker trigger transfers when users opened the app. Private keys remained on users' devices.
items.sourceTitle: Bitquery Traces at Least $1.58 Million in Fluidkey Hack

items.headline: Aave V4 proposal would route idle USDC into Circle Gateway
items.summary: A proposed Aave V4 plan would let idle USDC be swept into Circle Gateway, with exposure capped at 10 million USDC and 25% of supply. Cash would still be kept available for withdrawals and loans.
items.sourceTitle: Aave V4 Plan Would Put Idle USDC Into Circle Gateway

items.headline: BENQI Proposes Queue to Cut sAVAX Unstaking Delays
items.summary: BENQI plans a new queue system to shorten waits for sAVAX unstaking. Pending requests will carry over with their elapsed time preserved, and existing holders won't need to move or swap tokens.
items.sourceTitle: BENQI Plans New Queue to Shorten sAVAX Unstaking Waits

items.headline: Sky disputes illicit fund claims amid $2B stablecoin outflows
items.summary: Sky says its USDS stablecoin kept its $1 peg despite over $2 billion in withdrawals. The protocol is also contesting a report that links it to illicit activity.
items.sourceTitle: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims

items.headline: JPMorgan says bitcoin's drop widens gap to production cost
items.summary: JPMorgan estimates bitcoin's production cost at $86,000, and a recent price decline has increased the distance between that figure and the market price. The excerpt gives no further detail.
items.sourceTitle: JPMorgan says bitcoin price correction widens gap to estimated $86,000 production cost

items.headline: Bitcoin falls under $59,000 as crypto liquidations exceed $1.5 billion
items.summary: Bitcoin dropped below $59,000 on Friday, touching a multi-month low of $58,701. The decline extends a sharp November sell-off and leaves the asset down more than 30% for the year so far.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Price Crashes Below $59K as Crypto Liquidations Top $1.5B

items.headline: Bitcoin dips under $60,000 in live market update
items.summary: Bitcoin's price has fallen below $60,000, according to a live market report. The excerpt provides no further details on the cause or scope of the decline.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin crash live: price below $60,000 - CryptoTicker.io

items.headline: Bitcoin falls to four-month low as tech stocks weaken
items.summary: Bitcoin remains under pressure following Anthropic's IPO, while Nasdaq futures have slipped below their 200-day average.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin hits four-month low after Anthropic's IPO as tech stocks wilt

items.headline: Bitcoin Drops to Mining Cost as Hashrate Nears Peak
items.summary: Bitcoin has reached roughly $62,000, a level tied to mining costs, while network hashrate approaches a record. On-chain data is cited as still pointing to further downside.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Falls to Mining Cost Level as Hashrate Nears Record and Indicators Flip Bearish

items.headline: Optimism's OP token falls 25% weekly, lagging Bitcoin
items.summary: The Optimism governance token has dropped about 39% over 28 days, erasing its October gains. Ether declined less steeply across both time windows.
items.sourceTitle: Optimism’s OP Drops 25% in a Week, Trailing Bitcoin

items.headline: Bitcoin hits new selloff low at $61,220 on Coinbase
items.summary: Bitcoin fell to a fresh low of $61,220 on Coinbase, with its losses over roughly four weeks reaching 24.6% according to CoinGecko. Most tokens on a watchlist also declined over the past day.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Sets New Selloff Low of $61,220 on Coinbase

items.headline: Coinbase reportedly plans its own US prediction markets
items.summary: Bloomberg reports that Coinbase is planning in-house prediction market contracts in the US, which currently rely on Kalshi. The offering would target retail and institutional customers, with a launch aimed at the first half of 2027.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase Plans In-House US Prediction Markets: Bloomberg

items.headline: Bitcoin forms death cross as Anthropic IPO fails to lift stocks
items.summary: Bitcoin slipped after Anthropic's shares jumped on their Nasdaq debut while broader stocks fell. Bitcoin's daily chart shows deeply oversold momentum and a strong downtrend.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin Enters Death Cross as Anthropic IPO Fails to Lift Wall Street

items.headline: Sky lifts stUSDS yield; app shows zero withdrawal liquidity
items.summary: Sky raised the stUSDS yield to 24.74%, and a later app snapshot showed no withdrawal liquidity. A borrower's repayment and a bot's redemption came just before the rate change.
items.sourceTitle: Sky Raises stUSDS Yield to 24.74%; App Shows $0 Liquidity

items.headline: Higher rates may curb Bitcoin buying by treasury firms
items.summary: Treasury companies holding Bitcoin could find it harder to issue new shares on terms that justify further purchases, even when dividends are well covered. The excerpt suggests rising interest rates as the pressure point.
items.sourceTitle: Why higher rates could slow Bitcoin buying at treasury firms

items.headline: Kraken parent Payward agrees to buy Tribe Capital
items.summary: Payward, the parent company of Kraken, is acquiring Tribe Capital to broaden its private-market offerings. The move adds private-market sourcing, underwriting and fund management capabilities to Payward's platform.
items.sourceTitle: Kraken parent Payward to acquire Tribe Capital to expand private-market offerings

items.headline: Bitcoin Testnet5 launches so miners can trial four proposed fixes
items.summary: A new Bitcoin test network lets mining pools check the blocks their software builds while Bitcoin Core and Sparrow Wallet prepare support.
items.sourceTitle: Bitcoin launches Testnet5 and gives miners a real trial of four proposed fixes

items.headline: Three firms finish trial of tokenized deposit interoperability
items.summary: Standard Chartered, StraitsX and OCBC have completed a trial focused on interoperability for tokenized deposits. The companies argue that cross-platform compatibility is needed for such deposits to reach their full potential.
items.sourceTitle: Standard Chartered, StraitsX, OCBC complete trial of tokenized deposit interoperability

items.headline: Ondo Finance Joins MAS Project Guardian on Asset Tokenisation
items.summary: Ondo Finance has joined Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore initiative Project Guardian, which focuses on developing tokenised assets in financial markets. The firm will contribute its experience bringing tokenised assets to investors.
items.sourceTitle: Ondo Finance Joins MAS’ Project Guardian to Support Asset Tokenisation

items.headline: CoinGecko gains Solana Foundation support, explores adding crypto trading
items.summary: Data platform CoinGecko has received backing from the Solana Foundation and is looking at trading features. Details on how and when such trading would launch have not been provided.
items.sourceTitle: CoinGecko secures Solana Foundation backing and eyes crypto trading

items.headline: Coinbase AI system stops $4.7M in deepfake Musk scam transfers
items.summary: Coinbase says its AI defense system stopped about 91% of attempted transfers tied to a fake Tesla livestream, with no human involvement.
items.sourceTitle: Coinbase AI defense blocks $4.7 million from being sent to deepfake Elon Musk scam

items.headline: Crypto startup valuations diverge as top firms hit new highs
items.summary: Crypto unicorns from the 2021 boom now trade at steep secondary-market discounts of 50% to 70%. Meanwhile, the leading companies have reached new valuation highs.
items.sourceTitle: What’s happening to crypto startup valuations?

items.headline: DBS and Circle add round-the-clock USDC access for institutions
items.summary: Eligible institutional clients can now mint and redeem USDC through DBS, giving them a bank-based route to dollar stablecoin liquidity in Asia.
items.sourceTitle: DBS, Circle Add 24/7 Institutional USDC Access in Asia

items.headline: Fed's Waller Expects Stablecoins and Tokenized Deposits to Coexist
items.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller expects stablecoins, tokenized bank deposits and other digital payment instruments to operate side by side as blockchain becomes more integrated into traditional finance. He said the payments future will likely include several forms of tokenized money alongside existing banking infrastructure.
items.sourceTitle: Fed Governor Sees Stablecoins, Tokenized Deposits Coexisting in Financial System
